invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null String, either a substring of name or name itself, both of which are non-null if name is non-null.
If name is an empty string, result will also be empty. Otherwise, result contains at least one character. The method appears not to return null or a string with negative length.
The method is always called with a non-null String, as invoking contains or lastIndexOf on a null would throw an exception.
Captures exactly how result is computed based on whether the condition is true or false.
Result is either the original name or the substring after the last slash, depending on 'atlas_imagelayer' in name.
